sentences.en: while others are only truly good the day they are baked?
sentences.zh: 而另一些饼干只有在刚烤出来的那天才是真正好吃的？

sentences.en: How do I pick recipes or pack cookies to last?
sentences.zh: 我该如何选择食谱或包装饼干以使其保存更久？

sentences.en: You know, I think that there's a variety of factors of how cookies can keep.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为饼干的保鲜程度取决于多种因素。

sentences.en: Obviously, what you're storing them in, Melissa brought the cookies in today in an airtight container, always suggests that.
sentences.zh: 显然，你存放饼干的容器——梅丽莎今天就是用密封容器装饼干带来的——总是能起到保鲜作用。

sentences.en: If you're storing them in like a zip-top bag, for example, there is room for a lot of air to kind of get in there and steal your cookies out.
sentences.zh: 如果你是用自封袋之类的东西存放，里面会有很多空气，这会“偷走”你的饼干（导致变质）。

sentences.en: But ultimately, it kind of just depends on the ratios of fat in the recipe a lot of the time, or if there's oats, for example, in a recipe.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，这通常取决于配方中脂肪的比例，或者配方里是否有燕麦之类的成分。

sentences.en: Those are going to draw a lot of moisture out of your cookie.
sentences.zh: 那些成分会吸走饼干里的大量水分。

sentences.en: I love a Snickerdoodle cookie because the traditional Snickerdoodle has cream of tartar in it.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢士力架饼干（Snickerdoodle），因为传统的士力架饼干里含有塔塔粉。

sentences.en: Cream of tartar is this kind of acidic thing that honestly makes the cookies better and softer on day two or day three a lot of the time.
sentences.zh: 塔塔粉是一种酸性物质，老实说，它通常能让饼干在第二天或第三天口感更好、更松软。

sentences.en: So I think that those types of cookies do keep really well.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这类饼干保存得非常好。

sentences.en: Your, like, softer, chewier cookies.
sentences.zh: 就是那种口感更软、更有嚼劲的饼干。

sentences.en: But also a shortbread, if it's very snappy and, you know, tender, I think is a good cookie that we'll keep for a long time.
sentences.zh: 但黄油饼干（shortbread）如果烤得非常酥脆且松软，我觉得也是一种可以长时间保存的好饼干。

sentences.en: I have this brownie cookie recipe that also, I think, tastes better on day two or day three.
sentences.zh: 我有一个布朗尼饼干配方，我也觉得它在第二天或第三天吃起来味道更好。

sentences.en: It's just, if you're storing them correctly, you know, they're not going to stale as much.
sentences.zh: 只要你储存得当，它们就不会那么快变质。

sentences.en: I think that the only ones that really are the best on the day that they're made are the chocolate chips.
sentences.zh: 我觉得只有巧克力豆饼干是刚出炉时最好吃的。

sentences.en: Chocolate chip cookies are just amazing on day one.
sentences.zh: 巧克力豆饼干在第一天吃简直太棒了。

sentences.en: Gluten-free chocolate chip cookies, however, last a lot longer.
sentences.zh: 不过，无麸质巧克力豆饼干的保质期要长得多。

sentences.en: I'm glad I got them on day two here, Melissa.
sentences.zh: 梅丽莎，很高兴我是在第二天吃到的。

sentences.en: No, no, but they're, though, gluten-free is actually, it is actually a different chemical.
sentences.zh: 不，不是的，无麸质饼干其实……它的化学成分确实不同。

sentences.en: No, they're very good.
But, no, chocolate chip cookies, because you want them soft, right?
sentences.zh: 但巧克力豆饼干，你肯定希望它是软的，对吧？

sentences.en: You want them, and you want them a little warm.
sentences.zh: 你希望它们吃起来带点温热感。

sentences.en: I mean, that's the real joy of it is within a few hours so that they keep that texture.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，真正的乐趣在于出炉后的几个小时内，这样它们才能保持那种口感。

sentences.en: But otherwise, I think most cookies keep pretty well.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，我觉得大多数饼干都能保存得很好。

sentences.en: And cookies with spices and cookies that have chocolate in them get better because their flavors settle.
sentences.zh: 含有香料和巧克力的饼干会因为风味融合而变得更好吃。

sentences.en: And so, if you're looking for cookies that get better after day two, day three, find, like, a spice cookie, like a Snickerdoodle, for example, that would have, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你想找那种在第二天、第三天味道更好的饼干，可以找像士力架饼干那样的香料饼干，比如里面加了……

sentences.en: some nutmeg in it.
Or gingerbread, of course, keeps, gingerbread keeps, like, a month.
sentences.zh: 或者姜饼，当然，姜饼可以保存一个月。

sentences.en: It really does because there are so many spices in there.
sentences.zh: 确实如此，因为里面加了太多的香料。

sentences.en: So, you put them in, as long as you store them properly, airtight, they're going to laSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，只要你储存得当，密封保存，它们就能存放很久。

sentences.en: One more question on this theme.

sentences.zh: 这是来自弗吉尼亚州斯塔福德的波莉提出的。

sentences.en: She says that she and a friend, they have this tradition of baking all their holiday cookies together over the course of, you know, a long weekend.
sentences.zh: 她说她和朋友有一个传统，就是在一个长周末里一起烘焙所有的节日饼干。

sentences.zh: 我们回家时会带上几十甚至上百块饼干。

sentences.en: What is the best way to wrap cookies to store in the freezer for later?
sentences.zh: 为了以后食用，冷冻饼干的最佳包装方式是什么？

sentences.en: That you really want, an airtight container with layers of parchment in between the cookies.
sentences.zh: 你确实需要一个密封容器，并在饼干之间铺上羊皮纸。

sentences.en: So, you get, I actually have a few of these.
sentences.zh: 所以，你可以……我其实有几个这样的容器。

sentences.en: I have these big airtight containers.
sentences.zh: 我有这些大的密封容器。

sentences.en: You do one layer of cookies.
You make sure that they are not overlapping.
You want them flat in the container.
sentences.zh: 你要让它们平铺在容器里。

sentences.en: And then you take some parchment paper, lay it on top, and then do another layer.
sentences.zh: 然后拿一些羊皮纸铺在上面，再放下一层。

sentences.en: You really need a lot of freezer space because the containers are big.
sentences.zh: 你确实需要很大的冷冻空间，因为容器很大。

sentences.en: But they freeze perfectly.
sentences.zh: 但它们冷冻效果非常好。

sentences.en: They really do.
The cookies that freeze well, if you freeze them like that.
sentences.zh: 如果像那样冷冻，饼干的冷冻效果会很好。

sentences.en: I think most cookies really do freeze pretty well.
sentences.zh: 我觉得大多数饼干冷冻起来效果都不错。

sentences.en: I mean, not meringues.
Meringues don't freeze well.
But, you know, your average cookies are going to freeze perfectly.
sentences.zh: 但普通的饼干冷冻起来效果完美。

sentences.en: I do them that way, and they'll last at least a month, if not more.
sentences.zh: 我就是那样做的，它们至少能保存一个月，甚至更久。

sentences.en: You know, I learned this trick.
sentences.zh: 你知道吗，我学到了一个小窍门。

sentences.en: It might have been from you.
sentences.zh: 可能是从你那儿学来的。

sentences.en: I can't remember if it was from you or not, Melissa.
sentences.zh: 我不记得是不是从你那儿学到的了，梅丽莎。

sentences.en: But if you crumple up the parchment paper, it kind of fills in the pockets of the space in your airtight container.
sentences.zh: 但如果你把羊皮纸揉皱，它就能填满密封容器里的空隙。

sentences.en: So it almost acts more like a tissue paper that's food safe.
sentences.zh: 所以它几乎就像食品级的薄棉纸一样。

sentences.en: And that also keeps the cookies a little bit more protected, a little bit more insulated.
sentences.zh: 这也能让饼干得到更好的保护和隔热。

sentences.en: Also a good way to ship cookies, too.
sentences.zh: 这也是邮寄饼干的好方法。

sentences.en: If you want to ship cookies to your friends, again, pick those cookies that are going to be better on kind of day two or day three, obviously.
sentences.zh: 如果你想给朋友寄饼干，同样，显然要选那些在第二天或第三天口感更好的饼干。

sentences.en: But, yeah.
These are real pro tips right here.

sentences.zh: 我觉得，首先，我必须先说明一下，是梅丽莎带我入坑了批量制作鸡尾酒。

sentences.en: Oh, God.

Sorry.
I don't know if I should be blamed for that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这是否应该怪我。

sentences.en: No, you're not.
No, I'm just kidding, obviously.
But I think, you know, I love at the holidays a cider.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，你知道，我喜欢在节日里喝苹果酒。

sentences.en: Any type of, like, apple cider that you can add lots of warming spices to, citrus to.
sentences.zh: 任何你可以加入大量暖身香料和柑橘的苹果酒都可以。

sentences.en: You can steep those ingredients in the cider.
sentences.zh: 你可以把这些配料浸泡在苹果酒里。

sentences.en: And then, you know, you just have people spike it.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，让客人们自己加酒。

sentences.en: Some people like rum.
Some people like bourbon.
sentences.zh: 有些人喜欢波本威士忌。

sentences.en: Some people want vodka.
And there's, you know, I think that that's a fun way of kind of creating something that pleases all sorts of drinkers.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一种创造出能满足各种饮酒者需求的好方法。

sentences.en: And what I like to do also is I like to do a simple syrup that's infused with something, some really intense aromatics.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢做一种简单的糖浆，里面注入一些非常浓郁的芳香物质。

sentences.en: Like, I love rosemary and lemon.
sentences.zh: 比如，我喜欢迷迭香和柠檬。

sentences.en: That's a flavor profile that work really well with a bunch of different alcohols.
sentences.zh: 这种风味组合与多种酒精饮料搭配都非常出色。

sentences.en: And it's also, you can turn it into lemonade, right, with a sophisticated edge.
sentences.zh: 而且，你还可以把它变成柠檬水，对吧，带有一种高级感。

sentences.en: So, you make a simple syrup, really easy, equal parts sugar and water.
sentences.zh: 所以，你做一个简单的糖浆，非常容易，等量的糖和水。

sentences.en: And then you take some fresh rosemary and some lemon zeSt.
sentences.zh: 然后加入一些新鲜的迷迭香和柠檬皮。

sentences.en: Let it simmer for a few minutes.
Strain it.
And you have this lovely, herby, lemony, aromatic syrup.
sentences.zh: 你就得到了这种可爱的、带有草本和柠檬香气的糖浆。

sentences.en: And then that is what you can use as the base for all kinds of punches.
sentences.zh: 然后这就是你可以用来作为各种宾治酒基底的东西。

sentences.en: And mix it with seltzer.
It's really good.
It just makes this instant delicious soda that is so much better than Sprite.
sentences.zh: 它能瞬间做出一杯美味的汽水，比雪碧好喝多了。

sentences.en: But, you know, a crowd pleaser.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，这很受欢迎。

sentences.en: Should I be embarrassed to admit that I buy simple syrup?
sentences.zh: 承认我买现成的糖浆会让我感到尴尬吗？

sentences.zh: 只要拿糖和水，热水就行。

sentences.en: You can boil a kettle, put it on the sugar, let it sit there, and boom.
sentences.zh: 你可以烧一壶水，倒在糖上，让它静置，砰，就好了。

sentences.en: No, I mean, yes, conceptually, I understand what you're saying.
sentences.zh: 不，我的意思是，是的，从概念上讲，我明白你在说什么。

sentences.en: I make mine in a microwave.
Oh, even better.
You can literally just put equal parts sugar and water in a microwave, Gilbert, and in about two minutes, you've got it.
sentences.zh: 吉尔伯特，你真的可以直接把等量的糖和水放进微波炉，大约两分钟就搞定了。

sentences.en: Okay, we'll stop shaming him.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们别再羞辱他了。

sentences.en: If it's easier to buy it, buy it.
sentences.zh: 如果买现成的更容易，那就买吧。

sentences.en: You know what?
No, you know, if it works for people, it works for me.
sentences.zh: 不，如果这对别人有效，那对我来说也行。

sentences.en: Exactly.

sentences.zh: 那么，吉尔伯特，你有什么节日必备的饮品吗？

sentences.en: There is one that I made a couple years ago that I feel like I only break out around the holidays because there are way too many ingredients involved.
sentences.zh: 有一次我几年前做过一种，我觉得我只会在节日期间拿出来，因为涉及的配料实在太多了。

sentences.en: But it's sort of like a cranberry-orange Manhattan definitely is too sweet because after two, your sugar is just way too high.
sentences.zh: 但它有点像蔓越莓橙子曼哈顿，绝对太甜了，因为喝两杯之后，你的糖分摄入就太高了。

sentences.en: But it's, you know, rye or bourbon, cranberry juice, you know, get some orange bitters in there or some orange juice.
sentences.zh: 但它是，你知道，黑麦或波本威士忌，蔓越莓汁，加点橙味苦精或橙汁。

sentences.en: Maybe you top it off with a little ginger beer to give it a little kick, and you can batch it.
sentences.zh: 也许再加一点姜汁啤酒来提味，而且你可以批量制作。

sentences.en: That sounds great.

sentences.zh: 不过我喜欢梅丽莎说的那个主意，加入芳香物质。

sentences.en: I think whatever kind of base you're going with, adding rosemary, adding citrus, adding ginger root,
sentences.zh: 我觉得无论你用什么基底，加入迷迭香、柑橘、姜根，

sentences.en: those types of things are really going to kind of elevate your batch cocktail and make it feel just a little bit more special.
sentences.zh: 这些东西真的能提升你的批量鸡尾酒，让它感觉更特别一点。

sentences.en: I think ginger beer is really smart, too, because so you're adding that and you're giving it a kick.
sentences.zh: 我觉得姜汁啤酒也很聪明，因为你加入了它，就给酒增添了风味。

sentences.en: So, in a way, ginger beer is like an infused thing that you don't have to actually make.
sentences.zh: 所以，在某种程度上，姜汁啤酒就像是一种你不需要亲自制作的浸泡配料。

sentences.en: You can buy.

sentences.zh: 不要把姜汁啤酒放进鸡尾酒摇酒壶里。

sentences.en: Top it off afterwards.

sentences.en: what's a good main course meat to serve that's not a ham or turkey but not so easy to overcook or expensive like a prime rib?

sentences.en: Oh, I say I'm a big stew person, a braise of stew.
sentences.zh: 哦，我说我是炖菜的忠实粉丝，炖肉。

sentences.en: So, like, lamb shanks or short ribs because you can make it ahead.
sentences.zh: 所以，比如羊腿或牛小排，因为你可以提前做好。

sentences.en: It's festive.

sentences.en: Oh, it's the – it's a lifestyle.

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，除了我丈夫，我不喜欢为任何人现做现吃。

sentences.zh: 真的，我不想做——我不想冒险。
